Amazon Web Services is down, taking a big chunk of the internet with it

Published 2026-10-07 09:55 UTC

If your apps are not loading this morning, you are not alone: Amazon Web Services is having a major outage. Slack, Venmo, Ring doorbells, Fortnite, Duolingo and even some of Amazon's own services, including Alexa, are failing or loading slowly.

Amazon's AWS Health Dashboard says it is investigating increased error rates in the US-EAST-1 region, which covers data centers in northern Virginia. The problem appears to have started with DynamoDB, Amazon's database service, before spreading to EC2 and Lambda.

Downdetector shows millions of outage reports. AWS says it is seeing signs of recovery, but warns that a backlog of requests means some services will stay degraded for hours. We will update this story as services return.
